summary: # Overview of New Features in Marvelous Designer 2025.2 Marvelous Designer has introduced five new features in 2025. This update focuses on improving the realism of clothing design, enhancing working efficiency, and boosting creative performance. Let's explore the updated content together. ## New Attribute Key Pins Now, you can create key pin animations for more content, such as version attributes, accessories, and fake sewing needles. Through these new key pin animations, we have developed the following demonstration content for you. ### Inflatable Animation Example We created an inflatable animation for a little robot. To achieve this effect, we first need to use the attribute of the first new key pin animation: the shrink. We will increase the shrink and then decrease it at the end of the version, making the fabric wrapped around the robot larger in both horizontal and vertical directions. Next, we need to adjust the pressure. By adding key pins to the pressure value and gradually increasing it, our robot will be able to achieve the inflatable effect. You can set the positive and negative pressure using key pins to accurately depict the inflatable or compressed animation process. By adding key pins to the shape optimization, you can control the fabric to maintain the wrinkle shape while recording the animation. We will use this function to keep the wrinkle shape after the robot inflates, reducing excess wrinkling during movement. In another example, when we simulate a jump, we use a shirt and increase the strength of the shape optimization to minimize movement distortion. This helps to maintain the shape during the swing. To demonstrate the key pin animation, we will sew a small ball into the robot's hand and simultaneously increase the strength of the sewing needle while reducing the wrinkling effect, allowing the ball to drop to the ground. However, don't worry; we will return the ball to the little robot. To achieve this, we will use the last new key pin attribute: the negative weight. Since the ball body acts as a negative key, we can instantly reduce its weight through the key pin as it touches the ground. This makes the ball lighter, and the negative wind will pull it back into the robot's hand. ## Change the Key Pin The key pin can now be transformed into a key pin or a virtual model accessory. This feature simplifies the creation and management of materials in Marvelous Designer, enabling you to build a reusable accessory box and design with hard surfaces. ### Butterfly Accessory Example To illustrate the advantages of this feature, we use the creation of a butterfly accessory as an example. First, we use the conventional key pin production method to create a butterfly shape. Afterward, we can convert it into a key pin and add it to the suit. Once converted to a key pin, the butterfly no longer participates in physical simulation as clothing, saving computing resources and enhancing efficiency. Another advantage of this feature is that it allows for the creation of rigid objects directly within Marvelous Designer, such as plastic, wood, or metal items. For instance, the metal armor on this suit was originally made as a clothing fabric and was then converted to a key pin. As a key pin, it remains rigid and will not deform during simulation. You can use the armor tool to fix the key pin on the suit, enabling us to create a meaningful armor knight. Additionally, we can now convert the suit into a virtual model configuration. For the long sleeve of the knight, we first convert it into a configuration and select the appropriate type. After this, you can easily add the long sleeve to the new virtual model and apply it to other projects. ## Exporting FBX Files In previous versions, files optimized through the Everywhere function needed to be uploaded to the Connect platform to export FBX files. Now, you can directly optimize local resources and export FBX files. This latest option replaces the original Connect option, with the location remaining unchanged. ### Export Steps The specific steps for exporting FBX files are as follows: 1. Open Everywhere. 2. Optimize the clothing file. 3. Bind the skeleton. 4. Fill in the UV. 5. Prepare the sticker. After completing the above optimization steps, you can select to export the file as an FBX file to your local file folder. ## MetaHuman Integration MetaHuman with DNA format can now be imported into Marvelous Designer as a virtual model. Through the new workflow, users can directly import the MetaHuman model into Marvelous Designer without losing any data information, allowing for seamless clothing design for MetaHuman characters. Once production is completed in Marvelous Designer, you can return all content to MetaHuman Creator. At this point, the clothing will automatically adjust according to the character’s body type. This compatibility enhancement simplifies the creation of high-quality background clothing for MetaHuman, providing unprecedented convenience. ## Handmade Tools Handmade tools are often time-consuming and typically require precise calculations. The newly introduced handmade tools can be adjusted to the exact size via an intuitive interface, allowing you to easily add a knife, a bow, and a seal to the version. This innovation completely changes the traditional approach that relies on manual calculations and adjustments, enabling you to invest more time into clothing design and folding. If you are not satisfied with the effect, you can simply cancel one item and immediately adjust the version in the menu without the need for repeated changes. With more options and simpler steps, it will become easier and more convenient to add clothing items such as couplets, half-body dresses, and costumes. ## Conclusion Come and update to the 2025.2 version to experience the five major updates and other highlights for yourself. For more information, please browse the official website or check out subsequent video content updates.
